lines.text: Query: how many times did you answer "are you open on Sunday" this week?
Result: too many. Also detected: "do you have parking?" "Is the patio open?" "Do you take reservations?"
It answered the parking question AGAIN? I love it.
This is your FlowPilot speaking. Your FAQ bot answers the same questions all day, so your staff can focus on the food. Save this one. You're still the captain.
